headline: Executive order sets up the Presidential Innovation Fellows Program, which brings outside innovators into federal government work.
what_it_does: This order deals with the Presidential Innovation Fellows Program. Based on its title, it sets up or formalizes a program that places fellows, generally people with technology, design, or business skills from outside government, inside federal agencies for a limited time to work on projects. No official summary was provided, so details such as how fellows are chosen, how long they serve, and which agency runs the program are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Technologists, designers, and other professionals from outside government
who_it_affects.how: They may apply to serve as fellows and work on federal projects for a set period.
Agencies may host fellows who help with projects inside their offices.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 17, 2015; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
